blurb: Guests play paintball on various themed fields including dense woods, a town with buildings and a bus, and a WWII-inspired field with sandbag bunkers and a downed airplane. The center offers play all day or night under the lights. All ages and experience levels are welcome, with low-impact options for those under 10 or first-timers.
